description: Samples a signal into a working value and adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides it by sampled values, with rounding, quantizing, slew and out-of-bounds gates

params.text: Picks how the result is presented: floating point, rounded to the nearest .1, .2 or .5, rounded to a whole number, or quantized to the nearest note
Samples the signal input, adds the offset, and loads the result as the working value
Attenuates and inverts the signal input before it is sampled
Offsets the signal input before it is sampled, and sets a fixed value on its own when nothing is patched
Performs that operation on the working value, using the value held in its box
Samples that operation's value input, adds the offset, and shows the result in its box
Attenuates and inverts that operation's value input before it is sampled
Offsets that operation's value input before it is sampled, and sets a fixed value on its own when nothing is patched
Limits the output to between -10V and 10V
Resets the module in whichever ways are ticked in the Reset Behaviours menu
Resets the module whenever the result goes outside the bounds
Samples the lower bound input and adds its offset
Samples the upper bound input and adds its offset
Attenuates and inverts the lower bound input before it is sampled
Attenuates and inverts the upper bound input before it is sampled
Offsets the lower bound input before it is sampled, and sets a fixed lower bound on its own when nothing is patched
Offsets the upper bound input before it is sampled, and sets a fixed upper bound on its own when nothing is patched
Sets how long the output takes to travel from the previous result to the current one, in milliseconds
Attenuates and inverts the slew CV input
Attenuates and inverts the output
Chooses which channel the readouts show

inputs.text: Modulates which output mode is in use
The signal sampled into the working value
A trigger samples the signal input, adds the offset, and loads the result as the working value
A trigger performs that operation on the working value, using the value held in its box
The signal sampled into that operation's value
A trigger samples that operation's value input, adds the offset, and shows the result in its box
A trigger resets the module in whichever ways are ticked in the Reset Behaviours menu
The signal sampled into the lower bound
The signal sampled into the upper bound
A trigger samples the lower bound input and adds its offset
A trigger samples the upper bound input and adds its offset
Modulates the slew time, through its attenuvertor

outputs.text: The calculation result, after the output mode, the slew, the attenuvertor and the clip switch
A gate while the result is below the lower bound
A gate while the result is above the upper bound
A gate while the result is within the lower bound
A gate while the result is within the upper bound

notes: dividing by 0 does nothing to the working value
the working value changes only when something is sampled or an operation is fired, by the buttons on the panel or the trigger inputs
menu: Reset Behaviours ticks what a reset does: Initialize Parameters, Zero Calculation, Reset Slew, and a Zero and a Sample item for the signal, each operation value and each bound
